newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker prices firmer, average enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker prices firmer, average enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices on Monday were quoted slightly higher from Friday, in line with higher paper quotes, traders said.
"Enquiries were average today," said a trader. "Prices were also very volatile, very far apart," he said.
Bunker 180 cst was quoted between $120-$124 per tonne and 380 cst at $115-$119, traders said.
Prices on Friday were quoted between $116-$118 for 380 cst and at $119-$120 for 180 cst.
MDO also rose, to $200-$205 from $196-$202 and gas oil to $215-$216 from $209-$213. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703086).
